_about: Every way the maps differ between website, iPhone and Android, and what is owed. scripts/mapparity.py refuses a push that changes one platform's map without touching this file; qa check_map_parity_ledger() holds its shape. status: open (a platform owes the change), one-sided (different on purpose, with why), done. Hidde, 2026-11-20: "niet alles moet hetzelfde maar als het kan wel".

rows.what: The map itself: zoom buttons, one locate button, the place kept in the address, the trees, the card, the list that lights a pin
rows.web: one component, atTreeMap (tree-map-js.ts), on the city map, /explore, the country and state maps and the profile map; the fullscreen button (city map only) and the city map's own locate button are gone; the state pages' map stays an embedded box (no scroll zoom, no locate)
rows.ios: one map, TreeMap.swift, on every map screen
rows.why: the same map on each platform; the controls follow the platform (MapLibre's buttons on the web, the app's own recentre button over the sheet, CONVENTIONS.md "A my-location control over a bottom sheet")

rows.what: The one tree pin: moss disc, white ring, species in white, 1.5x when chosen, moss dots
rows.ios: TreeMap.swift pin(colour:...), the source of the numbers; qa pin_spec_problems() holds the web to it
rows.android: TreeMapView.kt pinBitmap(), PinRules; qa android_pin_problems() holds it to PIN_SPEC

rows.what: A dot only where it stands clear of every pin and every other dot (Airbnb's mini-pins); the rest wait for a zoom
rows.web: tree-pins-js.ts place(): dots filtered to those that clear the full pins
rows.ios: TreeMap.swift: dots and minis a symbol layer that may not overlap, under the pins (2026-11-20, in the next build)
rows.android: TreeMapView.kt: the same symbol layers (2026-11-20, in the next build)

rows.what: Pointing at a tree in the list lights its pin
rows.web: atPinsFollowList (tree-pins-js.ts) on every map with a list
rows.why: a phone has no pointer to hover with; Airbnb's apps have none either

rows.web: Airbnb's card floats on the map (map-card-js.ts)
rows.ios: the tree's own card rises in the sheet (Apple Maps)
rows.why: Hidde chose both, CONVENTIONS.md "Tapping a pin on a map that has a list in a sheet" (2026-10-19, 2026-10-24)

rows.what: A tree chosen at launch (-select) while it is a dot
rows.web: the chosen tree is always a full pin (tree-pins-js.ts)
rows.ios: not seen (the 2026-11-20 check opened Baarn without a choice)
rows.android: seen once on the emulator with -select=brn_001 in Baarn: a second dot half under the first; without -select the map is as iOS. Not yet known whether the clear-dot change caused it
rows.owed: android: open Baarn with -select on the build before 2026-11-20 and this one; if new, the chosen layer must hide that tree's dot as iOS does (pinPredicate without the selected id)

rows.what: The nearest tree, when no tree is in view
rows.web: /explore: the one place card (browse-card.ts placeCardHtml), no photograph, name, km and city
rows.ios: MapTab.swift emptyHere: EmptyPlaceRow, tree icon, name, distance in the reader's units and city
rows.android: MapTab.kt: the same row as iOS
rows.owed: web: the distance in the reader's units (a .dist span for units-js.ts), as the apps say miles where the reader reads miles; it says km always

rows.what: Zoomed out, the list turns to the cities in view
rows.web: none since 2026-11-20: the city map's list stays its own trees at every zoom, the other places stay pins; /explore lists the trees in view
rows.ios: none: the map's list is always the trees in view
rows.decided: Hidde, 2026-11-20, both shown side by side: "B, bomen in beeld"
